evidence: AFM measurement of a 30 nm thick Hf xAlyCz film provided a root mean square (RMS) roughness of 1.7 nm, indicating that the film was topographically smooth and continuous. Figure 7 shows XRD spectra of as-deposited Hf xAlyCz films with various deposition and anneal conditions, revealing the presence of HfC crystalline peaks for the as-deposited film with ALD TiN cap. The HfC peaks are broad, indicating a polycrystalline phase.
